parsed.rationale: Both `NowPlayingItem` (AppServices package, `Shared/AppServices/Sources/AppServices/NowPlayingService.swift:23`) and `PlaycutSelection` (app:iOS package, `WXYC/iOS/Views/Playlist/PlaylistView.swift:23`) are `type-alias-object` kinds sharing two fields — `playcut:Playcut` identically, and `artwork` differing only in image type (`Image?` vs `UIImage?`). This is a textbook PAT opportunity: the shared structure can be captured in a protocol `PlaycutRepresentable` with an `associatedtype ArtworkImage` covering the platform-specific image type, while the `playcut: Playcut` requirement is concrete and shared. This avoids duplicating the structural contract across the framework boundary between `AppServices` and the iOS app target.
